title: Low-risk AML alert dismissal
decisionType: dismissal of alerts outside the typologies
description: VAOM v5 Section 7B. An alert may be dismissed in Band A only when it matches a known false-positive pattern (own-account transfer, salary, utility). Any other pattern, a structuring typology above all, fails a hard rule and is capped at review, whatever else scores well. PEP, sanctions and the reporting threshold are not here: they are the matrix row's non-delegable overrides, which apply regardless of score.
